title: [Quality Management] Receiving setup guide: don't offer the warehouse receipt Create trigger
summary: The Receiving setup guide now prevents creating Quality Management rules with unsupported warehouse receipt triggers that would never fire, limiting trigger options to Never and When Warehouse Receipt is posted.
key_points: The warehouse receipt trigger field now restricts to Never and When Warehouse Receipt is posted options only
Setup defaults of created trigger are not carried into the guide to prevent invalid rules
Finish action rejects unsupported trigger combinations with guidance to the Generation Rules page
Tooltip explains how to manually set up Warehouse Receipt Line rules for the created trigger
Existing rules and the Generation Rules page remain unchanged for manual rule creation
